$comment: Single source of truth for the phased rollout, per section 0c of careers-gftv-spec.md. The site, the Telegram bot, and the docs site all read this one file, so the three stay in step. Flipping a phase to shipped is the only edit needed when it goes live. No copy anywhere hardcodes a phase number. Phase names and descriptions carry a translated variant per non default language, because three separate consumers render them and they are content, not interface strings; everything else the site says comes from assets/i18n.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.description: Repo scaffold, the full database schema, the build status mechanism, and the shared server side helpers. Nothing to use yet, but everything after this sits on it.
phases.description_zh: 代码仓库结构、完整的数据库架构、开发进度机制，以及共用的服务端代码。目前还没有可直接使用的功能，但后续所有内容都建立在此之上。
phases.shipped_note: The status page you are reading, the phase notice, and the placeholder pages went live with this, along with switching between English and Chinese.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 您正在阅读的进度页面、阶段提示条和占位页面随此阶段上线，中英文切换功能也在此阶段上线。

phases.name: Authentication
phases.description: Creating an applicant account and signing in, with passkeys as a second factor, recovery codes, trusted devices, and the stay signed in choice. Staff sign in with an existing gftv.asia account and its second factor.
phases.description_zh: 注册申请人账户并登录，包含作为第二重验证的通行密钥、恢复码、受信任设备，以及保持登录状态的选项。员工使用现有的 gftv.asia 账户及其第二重验证登录。
phases.shipped_note: Creating an account, signing in, and getting back in went live with this. Passkeys are the second factor in both realms, so a fingerprint or a security key replaces typing a code. Recovery codes are the way back in if you forget your password, since this site has no email to send a reset link to.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 注册账户、登录，以及找回账户的功能随此阶段上线。通行密钥是申请人和员工两边的第二重验证，因此可以用指纹或实体安全密钥代替输入验证码。由于本网站不使用电邮，无法寄送重设链接，恢复码是您忘记密码时回到账户的途径。

phases.name: Browsing roles
phases.description: The home page and the job board at /search, with search, filters, tags, quick chips, and suggestions, plus the about and FAQ pages. Search works in both languages.
phases.description_zh: 首页和位于 /search 的职位板，包含搜索、筛选、标签、快捷筛选和搜索建议，以及关于和常见问题页面。搜索支持中英双语。
phases.shipped_note: The job board went live with this. Search, filter by team, tag, and commitment, and the four quick filters for what is new and what is closing soon. Every filter lives in the address bar, so a link you share opens exactly what you were looking at. Each card states whether the role is paid, read from the posting itself. Opening a posting to read it in full arrives in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 职位板随此阶段上线。可以搜索，按团队、标签和投入时间筛选，并有四个快捷筛选查看最新发布和即将截止的职位。所有筛选条件都记录在网址中，因此您分享的链接打开后，正是您当时看到的内容。每张职位卡都会说明该职位是否有薪水，这是读取职位本身的记录，而非笼统的说法。完整阅读职位信息将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Job postings
phases.description: The posting page itself, in either language, with the openings feed and shareable links that carry each role's own title and description. Includes reporting a translation that reads wrongly.
phases.description_zh: 职位信息页本身，可以任一语言阅读，包含职位数据源，以及分享链接时会显示该职位自身标题和简介的预览。也包含报告翻译问题的功能。
phases.shipped_note: Reading a posting in full went live with this. Every role now has its own page. It carries the whole description, what you would do, what we need from you, the commitment and the closing date, with nothing behind an account. Sharing a posting into Discord or Telegram shows that role's own title and summary, and not a generic site card. Switching language redraws the posting instantly, and a role we have not translated yet says so and is not hidden. Every posting also carries a link at the foot to report a translation that reads wrongly. Applying to a role arrives in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 完整阅读职位信息的功能随此阶段上线。每个职位现在都有自己的页面：完整说明、您会做些什么、我们的要求、投入时间和截止日期，全部无需账户即可阅读。把职位链接分享到 Discord 或 Telegram 时，显示的是该职位自身的标题和简介，而不是笼统的网站介绍。切换语言时职位信息会即时重新显示。尚未翻译的职位会明确标示，而不是被隐藏。每则职位信息底部也都有链接，可以报告读起来不对的译文。申请职位的功能将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Apply flow
phases.description: Applying to a role. The handoff to the application form, rating a posting, and the three month wait before you can apply to the same role again.
phases.description_zh: 申请职位、跳转至申请表单、为职位信息评分，以及再次申请同一职位前的等待期。
phases.shipped_note: Applying went live with this. Sign in and press Apply. The role's application form opens in a new tab, with your details already filled in where the posting is set up for it. When you come back we ask one question: did you apply? Answering is optional, nothing is locked if you skip it, and we will ask again next time without nagging. You can also rate how well the posting was written. Only the team sees that, and it never appears on the posting. Once you have applied, that role is closed to you for three months. The posting and the job board both show the date it reopens. Saving roles and your own list of applications arrive in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 申请职位的功能随此阶段上线。登录后点击申请，该职位的申请表单会在新分页中打开；若该职位已设置好，您的资料也会预先填入。回到本网站时我们只问一个问题：您申请了吗？回答与否都可以，不回答也不会限制任何功能，我们下次会再问一次，而不会反复打扰。您也可以为职位信息写得好不好评分。评分只有团队看得到，绝不会显示在职位页面上。申请过之后，同一个职位三个月内不能再次申请。职位页面和职位板都会写明可以再次申请的日期，不必点进去才知道。收藏职位和查看自己的申请记录将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Applicant dashboard
phases.description: My applications, saved jobs, outstanding tasks, and account settings including profile, password, and the danger zone.
phases.description_zh: 我的申请、收藏的职位、待办事项，以及账户设置，包括个人资料、密码和危险操作区。
phases.shipped_note: Your account area went live with this. Every role you have applied to or started is on one page. Each one shows the date, where it has got to, and any waiting period that is running. You can withdraw from a role there. That clears the waiting period, so changing your mind does not lock you out. Saving works everywhere. The bookmark on a card or on a posting keeps a role on your own list. A role that has since closed stays there instead of being quietly dropped. Outstanding tasks is one page for anything we need from you. A request from the team lands there, with a count beside it, so you never have to go looking. Account settings holds your details, an optional picture, and a clearly separated danger zone that asks three times before it does anything.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 您的账户中心随此阶段上线。您申请过或开始申请过的每个职位都在同一个页面上，附有日期、目前进展，以及正在计算中的等待期。您可以在那里撤回申请。撤回后等待期会一并清除，改变主意时不会因此被挡在门外。收藏功能在各处都能用。点击职位卡或职位页面上的书签，就会收进您自己的名单；已经截止的职位也会留在名单上，不会悄悄消失。待办事项页面集中显示所有需要您处理的事情。团队有事找您时就会送到这里，旁边还有数量提示，不必自己去找。账户设置页面则有您的资料、可自行选择的头像，以及独立划分的危险操作区，任何操作都会请您确认三次才会执行。

phases.name: Admin core
phases.description: The staff side of running the board. The overview, writing and publishing postings in every language, tracking applicants, and managing departments and tags.
phases.description_zh: 员工端的日常运作：总览、以分页式编辑器撰写和发布多语言职位信息、跟进申请人，以及管理部门和标签。
phases.shipped_note: The staff side of the board went live with this. Roles are now written, translated and published inside the portal. A posting can carry its full description in both languages, and say plainly whether it is still open. If you have applied to something, the team can see where your application has got to. They can ask you a question about it, and tell you once a decision has been made. Anything they need from you arrives in your outstanding tasks. A question there can now be a short set of questions, and not only a reply box. None of the staff pages are visible to applicants, and nothing about how you apply has changed.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 员工端的运作功能随此阶段上线。职位现在直接在本网站内撰写、翻译和发布，不再需要另行处理。每则职位信息都能以双语呈现完整说明，并清楚标示是否仍在招募。如果您申请过某个职位，团队可以看到您的申请进展、就申请内容向您提问，并在有结果时通知您。任何需要您处理的事情都会送到您的待办事项。团队提问时现在也可以附上几道问题，而不只是一个回复框。员工使用的页面申请人都看不到，申请方式也完全没有改变。

phases.name: Admin operations
phases.description: The rest of the dashboard: analytics, invitations and shortlists, managing staff and applicant accounts, portal settings, and the translation review queue. Volunteers who speak a language can be given access to improve its wording, and can suggest a correction by selecting the text that reads wrongly.
phases.description_zh: 后台的其余部分：数据分析、邀请与候选名单、管理员工和申请人账户、门户设置，以及翻译审核队列。会说某种语言的义工可以获得权限改进该语言的用词，并可以直接选中读起来不对的文字提出修改建议。
phases.shipped_note: The rest of the staff side went live with this, and one part of it is open to volunteers and not to staff. If you speak a language this site is offered in, you can be given access to improve its wording. You work through the roles and the site's own words in that language, and save drafts as often as you like. An admin makes them live. Anyone signed in can also select a phrase that reads wrongly on a posting. Suggest a better one where it stands, without leaving the page. If the team invites you to apply for a role, that invitation now arrives in your outstanding tasks like anything else they need from you. The rest is staff facing, and none of it is visible to applicants: how the board is doing, managing accounts, and the portal's own settings. Nothing about how you apply has changed.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 员工端的其余部分随此阶段上线，其中一部分开放给义工，而不只是员工。如果您会说本网站提供的某种语言，您可以获得权限改进该语言的用词。您可以逐一处理该语言的职位信息和网站用语，随时保存草稿，再由管理员正式发布。已登录的用户也可以直接选中职位信息中读起来不对的文字，就地提出修改建议，无需离开页面。如果团队邀请您申请某个职位，该邀请现在会像其他需要您处理的事情一样，送到您的待办事项。其余功能都是员工使用的，申请人都看不到：包括招聘情况数据、账户管理，以及网站本身的设置。申请方式也完全没有改变。

phases.name: Automation
phases.description: Daily maintenance, automatic closing of postings past their date, and confirmed submissions coming back from the application forms.
phases.description_zh: 每日维护、自动关闭已过截止日期的职位信息，以及从申请表单回传的提交确认。
phases.shipped_note: Most of this phase is meant to be invisible, and that is the point of it. Roles now close themselves on their closing date, so the board stops offering something that has already shut. The site also tidies up after itself once a day. Here is the part you may notice. Where a role's application form is set up for it, submitting that form tells us you applied, so we stop asking you the question. Say you had answered that you did not apply, and then went and applied. The form is believed over that earlier answer. Your applications page shows the role as submitted, and the three month wait for that role runs from when you actually applied. Nothing about how you apply has changed, and no role depends on this. Where a form is not set up for it, we ask you as before. Installing the portal to your home screen and using it with no connection arrive in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 这一阶段的内容大多是看不见的，而这正是用意所在。职位现在会在截止日期当天自动关闭，职位板不会再显示已经结束招募的职位。网站每天也会自动整理一次。您可能会注意到的部分是：如果某个职位的申请表单已经设置好这项功能，您提交表单后，我们就会知道您申请了，也就不会再问您那个问题。如果您先前回答了没有申请、后来又去申请了，我们会以表单为准。您的申请页面会显示该职位为已提交，该职位三个月的等待期也会从您实际申请的日期开始计算。申请方式完全没有改变，也没有任何职位必须依赖这项功能：若某个职位的表单没有设置，我们仍然像以前一样询问您。将本网站添加到主屏幕、并在没有网络时使用的功能，将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Offline
phases.description: Installing the portal to a home screen, and browsing, reading, and rating postings with no connection.
phases.description_zh: 将本网站添加到主屏幕，并在没有网络时浏览、阅读和评分职位信息。
phases.shipped_note: You can now add Careers@GFTV to your home screen and open it like an app, and it keeps working when your connection does not. With no signal you can still browse the board as you last loaded it. Any posting you have already opened is readable too, in either language. Your saved roles, your applications, and anything we have asked you for are all there. That comes from a copy kept on your own device, and cleared when you sign out. Rating a role and answering the did you apply question both work offline. They are shown as waiting to be sent, and they go through the moment you are back. An answer only counts once it reaches us, so the three month wait for a role starts then, and not when you tapped it. Some things genuinely need a connection: signing in, creating an account, the second step of signing in, and opening an application form. Each of those says so on the button itself, instead of failing when you press it. Linking a Telegram account for notifications and invitations arrives in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 现在您可以将国际兽视 Careers 添加到主屏幕，像应用一样打开，而且在没有网络时依然可以使用。没有网络时，您仍然可以浏览上次加载的职位板，也可以阅读您已经打开过的职位信息，两种语言都可以。您收藏的职位、您的申请，以及我们需要您处理的事项也都在。这些都来自保存在您自己设备上的副本，退出登录时会被清除。为职位评分和回答“您是否已申请”也可以在离线时进行：它们会显示为等待发送，等您恢复网络后立即送出。答复只有送达我们这里才算数，因此该职位三个月的等待期从送达时开始计算，而不是从您点击时开始。确实需要网络的操作有四项：登录、注册、登录的第二步验证，以及打开申请表单。这些都会直接在按钮上说明，而不是等您点击后才失败。关联 Telegram 账户以接收通知和邀请，将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Telegram bot
phases.description: Linking a Telegram account for notifications, invitations, one tap sign in, and two factor authentication, in your chosen language.
phases.description_zh: 关联 Telegram 账户以接收通知和邀请，并使用一键登录和双重验证，且使用您选择的语言。
phases.shipped_note: Linking a Telegram account went live with this. Open your account settings, scan the code with the phone your Telegram is on, and the bot takes it from there. Once linked, what the team needs from you reaches you in a chat as well as on this site. That means a question or a task raised against your application. It means an invitation to apply for a role, with the button to decline it on the invitation itself. And it means a decision once one is made, with whatever the person deciding wrote. You choose which of those three you want, in the chat, and turning one off never affects signing in. You can also ask the bot instead of waiting to be told. It answers with your invitations, your outstanding tasks, your applications and where each has got to, and the newest openings. All of it comes in the language your account is set to. Signing in gains two things. The first is one tap sign in, where the link the bot sends works only in the browser that asked for it. The second is an optional code at every sign in, as your second step. If you ever lose your phone, a two factor backup code is the way past it. Nothing arrives only in a chat. Everything the bot sends is on this site too, and unlinking leaves your account exactly as it is. An accessibility and responsive pass across every page, theme, language and screen size arrives in the next phase.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 关联 Telegram 账户的功能随此阶段上线。打开账户设置，用装有 Telegram 的手机扫描二维码，其余交给机器人完成。关联之后，团队需要您处理的事情除了出现在本网站，也会送到聊天中。包括针对您申请的提问或待办事项。也包括邀请您申请某个职位，婉拒的按钮就在邀请讯息上。还包括有结果时的决定，连同做出决定的人所写的说明。这三类通知您可以自行选择要收哪些，直接在聊天中设置；关闭通知绝不会影响登录。您也可以主动询问机器人，不必等我们通知。它会告诉您：您的邀请、您的待办事项、您的申请及各自的进展，以及最新发布的职位。全部以您账户设置的语言呈现。登录方面增加了两项。第一项是一键登录，机器人发来的链接只在提出请求的那个浏览器中有效。第二项是可自行选择的登录验证码，作为登录的第二步。万一手机不在身边，双重验证备用码就是通过这一步的途径。没有任何内容只出现在聊天中：机器人发送的一切在本网站上也都找得到，取消关联后您的账户也完全保持原样。针对每个页面、主题、语言和屏幕尺寸的无障碍与响应式检查，将在下一阶段上线。

phases.name: Polish
phases.description: An accessibility and responsive pass across every page, theme, language, and screen size, plus the discovery files search engines read.
phases.description_zh: 针对每个页面、主题、语言和屏幕尺寸进行无障碍与响应式检查，并加入供搜索引擎读取的站点文件。
phases.shipped_note: There is nothing new to use here, and that is the point: this phase was a pass over everything already built. Every page was measured at six screen widths, from a small phone to a desktop. That covered both languages, both colour themes, and both light and dark. Nothing overflows its box, nothing is cut off, and no text sits at a contrast that is hard to read. It was measured against the WCAG AA standard and not judged by eye, and the colours that had only ever been chosen were finally checked. Every dialog, tab strip and menu can now be worked with a keyboard alone. The parts of the site a screen reader used to pass over in silence now say what they are. The site can also be found now. It was closed to search engines for the whole build, so that nobody landed on something half finished. This phase opened it, with a sitemap listing every open role. One more thing was built and is not on screen yet. A service status page answers whether the site is working, and not what has been built. It takes the place of this page once the last phase has shipped. Next is the documentation site: guides to using this portal and the Telegram bot, with a sign in for the people running it.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 本阶段没有新功能可以使用，而这正是它的用意：这是一次针对已建成内容的全面检查。每个页面都在六种屏幕宽度下测量过，从小屏手机到桌面电脑，涵盖两种语言、两种配色主题以及浅色和深色模式。确保内容不会超出边框、不会被截断，也不会出现难以辨认的文字对比度。这些都是按照 WCAG AA 标准实际测量的，而不是凭肉眼判断，那些一直以来只是凭感觉选定的颜色，这次终于逐一量过。所有对话框、标签栏和菜单现在都可以只用键盘操作。屏幕阅读器过去默默略过的部分，现在也会说明自己是什么。本网站现在也能被搜索到了。整个开发期间我们都不让搜索引擎收录，以免有人看到尚未完成的内容。本阶段将其开放，并提供列出所有公开职位的站点地图。还有一项已经建好但尚未显示的功能：服务状态页面。它回答的是网站本身是否运作正常，而不是已经建成了什么；等最后一个阶段上线后，它就会取代本页面。下一阶段是说明文件网站：介绍如何使用本平台和 Telegram 机器人的指南，并为营运人员提供登录入口。

phases.name: Docs site foundations
phases.description: The documentation site itself, with a staff sign in on it. What a reader sees depends on their role. Applicants read the public guides, job posters also read the dashboard guide, and admins also read the admin and developer guides.
phases.description_zh: 说明文件网站本身，并附有员工登录功能。读者看到的内容取决于其身份：申请人可阅读公开指南，职位发布者另可阅读后台使用指南，管理员另可阅读管理与开发说明文件。
phases.shipped_note: There is a second website now: the documentation site, with the guides themselves still to come. What this phase built is everything underneath them. Anyone can read the public guides without signing in. The people running the portal sign in with the same account they use everywhere else. What they can read follows what they do. Somebody who posts jobs also sees the dashboard guide, and an administrator also sees the administration and developer guides. A page somebody is not allowed to read does not announce itself as forbidden. A list of things you cannot see is still a list, so it reads as a page nobody has written. Search behaves the same way, covering only what the reader may open, and a picture inside a restricted guide is restricted with it. The whole site is in English and 华文, which was not the original plan. Most of the wording turned out to be translated already for the portal, so the arithmetic answered a question that had been left open. It also carries the same account settings page as the portal. That means passkeys, an authenticator app, recovery codes, trusted devices, and a record of where the account is signed in. It is built once and shown on both sites, so the two cannot drift apart. Next is the documentation itself. Guides for applicants, for the Telegram bot, for people helping with translations, and for staff, in every language this site speaks.
phases.shipped_note_zh: 现在有了第二个网站：说明文件网站，指南内容本身还有待撰写，本阶段建成的是它底下的一切。任何人都可以阅读公开指南，无需登录。营运本平台的同仁使用平常那个账号登录，能读到什么取决于职务。负责发布职位的人另可看到后台使用指南，管理员另可看到管理与开发说明文件。读者无权阅读的页面不会声明自己是禁止进入的。一份你看不到的清单仍然是一份清单，所以它看起来就像一个还没有人撰写的页面。搜索也依循同样的做法，只涵盖该读者可以打开的内容，受限指南里的图片也一并受限。整个网站都提供英文和华文，这一点原本不在计划之内。后来发现大部分用语在求职门户里已经翻译过了，一道原本悬而未决的问题就这样由算术回答了。本网站也采用与求职门户相同的账号设置页面。当中包含通行密钥、验证器应用程序、恢复码、受信任的设备，以及账号在哪些地方登录的记录。这些只建一次、两边显示，两者就不会各走各的。下一阶段是说明文件本身：给申请人、Telegram 机器人、翻译义工和员工的各种指南，涵盖本网站支持的每一种语言。

phases.name: Documentation
phases.description: The guides themselves: how to use the portal and the bot in every language, how to help with translations, and the staff guides. Written late so they describe what was built, not what was planned.
phases.description_zh: 指南内容本身：各语言版本的求职门户与 Telegram 机器人使用说明、如何协助翻译，以及员工指南。刻意安排在后期撰写，以便描述实际建成的功能而非当初的计划。

phases.name: More languages
phases.description: Adding Malay and Tamil. The portal is already built to take them: a new language needs no database change, only its wording. Listed last because it depends on finding people to write and check it.
phases.description_zh: 加入马来文和淡米尔文。本网站的架构已经支持：新增语言无需改动数据库，只需要撰写内容。列在最后，是因为这取决于能否找到人撰写和校对。
